name: sx/offer-hero
title: SX Offer Hero
description: Lead promotion: value, code with copy, two key terms, Claim, verified date. Data from the brand promotion feed.

guardrails: Value, code, two key terms and Claim above the fold at 375x667.
Offer value, code and terms come only from brands/promotions/<brand>.json; content may only add a headline and subtitle.
No countdowns, no click-to-reveal; the verified date is always shown.
